info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Technology Standards API
info.description: The Update Technology Standards API allows organizations to refine and adjust their technology standards in the banking and IT management sectors. This endpoint facilitates modifications to existing standards, ensuring that institutions remain compliant with evolving regulations and best practices. Typical consumers include IT managers and compliance officers who need to maintain up-to-date standards within their organizations. The API supports seamless integration into internal systems for efficient updates and management of technology standards.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific technology standard identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify the standard as required.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating technology standards in our IT management system. This body should contain the necessary fields for the modification of the specified resource. Ensure that all required fields according to the schema are provided for successful processing.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
